description: Securely resolves adapter credentials from the client's encrypted vault (stored as a .env file) into ephemeral in-memory values before an adapter call is made. Reads the credential_env_vars list defined in the adapter catalog and fetches the corresponding values from the client vault. Credentials are never persisted to disk during resolution and are immediately discarded after the adapter call completes. Blocks any other pre-call hooks and the adapter call itself from running until credentials are successfully resolved. Prevents raw credential leakage by ensuring all values are vault-sourced.
use_cases: Fetching API keys, OAuth client secrets, and bearer tokens before adapter calls
Isolating credential access to the pre-call lifecycle phase
Preventing hardcoded credentials from entering the pipeline
Supporting per-client credential isolation in multi-tenant deployments
Auditing which credentials were resolved for each adapter call
when_to_use: Attach to every adapter that uses credentials (api_key, oauth2, bearer_token, basic_auth). Must run before all other pre-call hooks.
trigger_condition: Before any other pre-call hooks; runs first in the pre-call phase

input_parameters.description: Client workspace ID used to locate the credential vault
Adapter name whose credentials need to be resolved
List of env var names from the adapter catalog to resolve

output.on_success: Ephemeral in-memory credentials map returned; not persisted to disk
output.on_failure: Pipeline aborted for this adapter; missing credential name logged (not value); HOOK_003 raised

error_codes.HOOK_001: Failed to parse client vault (.env) format.
error_codes.HOOK_003: Named credential variable missing from vault.
